items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I think he was playing with Les Hite, who had a band at that time, and he did some traveling with Les Hite.

ctx.x: Here in Los Angeles. He happens to be from New York, but we met out here. I think he was playing with Les Hite, who had a band at that time, and he did some traveling with Les Hite. But I was busy. I had a trio at the time. And I used to play intermission, incidentally, at the Casa Manaña; I don't know whether I mentioned that before. But I was the intermission trio for the Duke Ellington and Charlie Barnet bands at the Casa Manaña, and also when Jimmy Dorsey played there. Well, I was the house utility trio, I…
